exclusions.source_text: Is ≥18 years of age at the time of signature of the main study ICF.
Has an ECOG PS of 0 or 1.
Is a female patient who is pregnant or lactating
Is known to be HIV positive, unless all the following criteria are met:
exclusions.threshold: CD4+ count ≥300/µL, undetectable viral load, receiving HAART

exclusions.source_text: Has known or suspected active or untreated CNS metastases associated with progressive neurological symptoms
Has current active liver disease from any cause
